figures.title: Чертеж зажима натяжного НАС-Б
figures.description: Main side view of the clamp: eye end at left (eye hole marked Ød1), angled conductor barrel to lower left, horizontal compressed barrel to right containing the conductor. Overall length L spans the full part; L1 spans a slightly shorter span from the eye; L2 measured along the horizontal barrel from near the crimp zone to the barrel end; H is the vertical overall height dimension at the right side; b is the width of the eye/strap at the left end; L3 is measured along the angled conductor barrel with the label 'направление опрессования' (crimping direction) alongside; a second 'направление опрессования' label appears at the barrel with an arrow. B marks the angled barrel width with extension lines. Lower left shows a small side detail of the barrel end with dimension b. Section view В–В (lower center) is a circular cross-section with diameter D and hole d. Exact endpoints of L, L1, L2 and L3 are only partially resolvable at image resolution.

source_notes: Footer: ООО «МЗВА-ЧЭМЗ», Тел./ факс: +7 (495) 780-51-65, e-mail: zakaz@mzva.ru, www.mzva.ru, стр. 102
uncertainties: Exact span boundaries of merged cells for L3/H (e.g. H=178, L3=110, H=192/196 and b=28/D=58,5) are visually estimated; row associations may be off by one group.
Assignment of breaking-load values 65,33 and 84,43 within НАС-240-1Б, and 113,2 / 101,8 within НАС-330-1Б, is approximate from cell borders.
Drawing dimension endpoints (L, L1, L2, L3, H, b, B, D, d) are described as seen; thin extension lines at image resolution leave some ambiguity.
